## Type of Change

- [ ] **Added**: New feature or functionality
- [ ] **Changed**: Changes to existing functionality
- [ ] **Fixed**: Bug fix
- [ ] **Removed**: Removed feature or functionality
- [ ] **Docs**: Documentation only changes
- [ ] **Chore**: Maintenance, refactoring, or dependencies

## Checklist

- [ ] **CHANGELOG.md updated** (required for functional changes)
  - Added entry under `[Unreleased]` section
  - Used appropriate category (Added/Changed/Fixed/Removed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] All CI checks passing

<details>
<summary>📝 CHANGELOG Guidelines</summary>

### When to update CHANGELOG:
- ✅ New features
- ✅ Bug fixes
- ✅ Breaking changes
- ✅ Deprecations
- ❌ Trivial changes (typos, formatting)
- ❌ Internal refactoring with no user impact

### How to update:
Add entry under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md:

```markdown
## [Unreleased]

### Added
- New RFD search command with filters

### Fixed
- Template rendering bug for nested sections
```

See [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/) for more examples.
</details>
